integrity: Complete derivation via eight-state balance automaton, its four closed classes and exact characteristic polynomials; finite direct enumeration and transfer polynomial checks supplied as supplementary reproducibility.
scientific_limitations: Odd labelled squared cycles n>=5 only for the claimed new bivariate coefficient distribution. Prior antiprism classification covers the even-order unweighted count. The 2007 Zhang–Shen paper is plausible scalar prior art but unavailable in full; its exact scope and any weighted refinement remain unverified.
title: Two-winding enumeration of Eulerian orientations on odd cycle squares
